calls.title: A refused pull request diff is read file by file
calls.chose: When GitHub refuses the whole diff, read its per-file list and each file's patch
calls.because: GitHub caps one whole diff at 20,000 lines but lists up to 3,000 files with a patch each
passed_over: Diff a local checkout (needs the pull request's commits fetched)

calls.title: A file list narrows as you type, best match first
calls.chose: Slash or a click filters the list; best match first, matched letters lit
calls.because: Parker asked for fuzzy search; a 208-file list is read by finding one file
passed_over: Keep path order and only hide what does not match
calls.undo: Sort filtered rows by path instead of score

reasons: both readings are medium under a standard posture

verdict.note: Parker chose 'Best match first' when asked, 2026-11-08

calls.title: The finder matches across the whole path, the name counting most
calls.chose: fzf-style scoring; outside the file's name, a gap must land on a word start
calls.because: The first pass refused letters across folders, which also refused src/fly for app/src/flyout.rs; letters strewn mid-word into other folders stay refused
passed_over: Letters in order within the file name only (the first pass)
calls.undo: Restrict matching to the file name again

calls.title: Every tab shows its close mark on the left, always
calls.chose: A quiet × left of every tab, red under the pointer; middle-click still closes
calls.because: Parker asked for it on the left; shown only under the pointer, it leaves an empty gap
passed_over: Only on the shown tab and under the pointer, as before
calls.undo: Hide the × on tabs not shown or hovered

calls.title: Pages, Markdown, pictures and PDFs open drawn, source one key away
calls.chose: Drawn by the floating square's own document view; s flips to source
calls.because: Parker opened tv.html and saw source; the square's engine already draws all four kinds
passed_over: Send the file to the floating square instead
calls.undo: Default a File tab to its source

calls.title: Files and Conversation faces wear a one-line pull request header
calls.chose: Overview keeps the full header; the other faces show one line
calls.because: On a 900-pixel panel the full header took a quarter of the height
passed_over: The full header on every face
calls.undo: Draw the full header on every face

reasons: both readings are medium under a standard posture

verdict.note: Parker chose 'One line there' when asked, 2026-11-08
